# Ack — branch-local API index

> Dart/Flutter schema validation, codecs, JSON Schema, and optional code generation.

This checkout documents Ack 2.0.0-beta.1. Read the local files linked below so
examples match the checked-out branch; the default branch can document 1.x.
Package `pubspec.yaml` files own SDK and dependency constraints.

## Contracts easy to miss

- `AckSchema<Boundary, Runtime>` distinguishes wire data from Dart runtime values.
  Parsing decodes; encoding validates and converts back. One-way transforms are
  runtime parse helpers and cannot back generated models that must encode.
- `safeParse` returns `SchemaResult`; programmer `Error` values in callbacks can
  still propagate. Use the error-handling guide for the failure contract.
- `optional` permits an omitted key; `nullable` permits a present null. Use
  `JsonMaybe<T>` when a class must preserve omitted versus explicit-null keys.
- `@Schemable`, `@AckKey`, and `@Validate.*` come from `package:ack/ack.dart`.
  Generation uses one `part '<file>.g.dart';` and `dart run build_runner build`.
  There is no `@AckSchema` annotation.
- Generated constructors are unchecked. Use `parse`/`fromJson` for untrusted
  input; generated JSON encoding validates. Hand-written constructors own any
  defensive copying required for direct construction.
- Generated models store typed fields or a `.value`; they do not implement Map,
  List, or scalar interfaces. The model-generation guide owns supported shapes,
  custom schema resolution, recursion, and unknown-property policies.
- `Ack.preserveBoundary` validates through the inner object parser but returns a
  detached immutable copy of the original JSON map, without invoking an encoder.
  Inner defaults do not materialize into that copy.
- Native schemas export Draft-7. Imported 2020-12 resources are preserved by
  default; request Draft-7 lowering explicitly and handle unsupported conversion.
  Formats are annotations unless assertion is requested or required by the dialect.
- Non-JSON adapters traverse `AckSchemaModel`; JSON-map adapters can use
  `toJsonSchema()`. Imported raw resources and references need explicit support.
- MCP adapters validate typed inputs; callbacks own outputs. Firebase's adapter
  passes JSON Schema through for `responseJsonSchema`, without provider-specific
  keyword normalization. Validate generated or received data with Ack.

Keep API examples and substitution tables in their owning guides. When a public
contract changes, update that guide and the index only where its links or sharp
limitations change. Preserve decision history in ARCHITECTURE.md.
